name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
summary: Low-premium crop insurance against yield loss from disease, pests and weather; enroll before the cutoff date each season.

name: Karnataka Raitha Siri / Krishi Bhagya
summary: State support for millets and input costs including farm ponds and micro-irrigation to reduce fungal disease pressure.

name: Telangana Rythu Bandhu
summary: Direct investment support per acre per season to help cover input and treatment costs.

name: PM-KISAN
summary: Direct income support of six thousand rupees per year in three installments to eligible landholding farmers.

name: State Input Subsidy Scheme
summary: Partial subsidy on approved fungicides and organic treatments purchased through registered cooperatives.
